_comment: Maps RC_COMPLAINT_EXTRACT.CMP_Issue_1/2/3 to tblComplaintRoot.RootCause. Keys are target labels, each list holds the source values to rewrite. Deliberately empty for SM9641: all six distinct CMP_Issue values (Charges, Advice, Service, Disclosure, Financial difficulty/debt collection, Scams/fraud) already match tblComplaintRoot.RootCause exactly on dev-debtrak, so no rewrite is needed. Note tblComplaintRoot carries the same labels twice - a legacy family on negative ids (-9101..-9113, hyphen spelling) and a current family on positive ids (24..39, em-dash spelling). 66.tblComplaint.sql orders by ComplaintRootId, so it resolves to the negative family. That is the intended one for this extract: the sub-issue spellings only exist there (for example 'Other service-related issue', singular, is under -9101 Service, while id 38 has the plural). Add explicit entries here if a future extract should target the positive family instead.
